notes: Not checker-run. I have no shell here, so every spacing and reach figure below is worked out by hand. Next owner runs `bun tools/plan/cli.ts`; any T-/S-/N- failure comes back to Vantage, or to Datum if it involves geometry.

S1 is listed again because Datum's stations break S-S2: Harbour 340 to Skyport 530 is 190 m, under the 200 m minimum. Harbour moves to x 332 (over the quay). Skyport moves to x 535, the farthest it can go and keep its 50 m platform straight before the loop at x 560. New spacings: 255, 237 and 203 m. No line geometry was moved.

T1 spacing along the path: 310, 308 and about 435 m. No stop fits in Crown Avenue. Spacing puts the next stop at y ≥ 228, but a 30 m platform before the R50 corner needs its centre at y ≤ 224. So the stop goes on Crown Road at x −90. T1's next stop, off-sheet, must be at x ≤ −390.

T2 spacing: 321.5, 350, 341.6, 326.6 and 305 m. The Market stop is at x 80 on the shallow diagonal, not at (0,−410), to keep it out of the Boulevard/Market junction and the tram crossing. It is 87 m from T1 Records. Placing it there brings harbour-east within 233 m.
Interchanges, each pair 150 m or less: T1/circus–S1/circus 119 m, T1/records–T2/market 87 m, S1/harbour–T2/parade 25 m. All three lines connect into one network (N-C1).

N-R1, worst cases by hand: crescent-east 190 m, crescent-north 193 m, docks-south 204 m (T1 Comet), docks-east 207 m, and the closest of all, records-square 217 m from T1 Records (232 m from Sphere Gardens). Every plot is within the 250 m reach.

For Datum: the plan has no ground at x 535 near the Skyport station (it is over water, and the skyport apron and island are not drawn). Its `fronts` is a placeholder of crown-parade. Please add skyport ground or a foot path, and I'll re-front the station. Datum's track geometry and junction polygons are still only hand-checked.

For Aster: the sources conflict. The concept note says T1 runs on an R28 balloon loop and that Crown Circus is the only interchange. This proposal follows Datum's run-through T1 and has three interchanges. Open question 2 still needs Sky to decide, and the notes need updating.
